name: The Mad Shepherd
source:
THIS STORY IS ABOUT AN ANGEL FALLING FROM HEAVEN, AND THE PRIEST TAKING HER IN...

A sidegame for Monster X Mediator focusing on ONLY room 003.

You play as Angel before her time at the hotel, have fun!

[From [url=https://headlocker.itch.io/the-mad-shepherd]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这个故事是关于一位天使从天堂坠落，牧师收留她……

Monster X Mediator的一款副游戏，仅专注于003号房间。

你在天使到达酒店之前扮演她，玩得开心！

[来自[url=https://headlocker.itch.io/the-mad-shepherd]Itch.io[/url]]
